categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches fuzz testing utilities and targets in src/test/fuzz/ with the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading mock behavior where FuzzedSock descriptor collisions caused CConnman::SocketHandler() to merge peer events, and adds realistic OS socket event handling to exercise previously unreachable network error paths. Commit fc3532c50c notes that 'every FuzzedSock had one of two socket values and CConnman::SocketHandler() merged the entries of different peers... which led the connman fuzz target to act on one peer with the events of another', directly improving fuzz signal and coverage on critical networking code.
